instagram.body:
X has launched Video Reaction Feature and here’s my 1-min UX Teardown of the feature.
X has just launched video reaction feature and people as usual are hating and resisting the change. And that's because X as a feed has been sacred for being a text first feed. The challenge right now for X product team is they want to introduce videos to the platform, but without flooding with TikToks and Instagram Reels reshars on the platform. They want original video content and this video reaction feature seems to be their best attempt at bridging text and videos. However, to take this feature to the next level, they should introduce auto captions so that we can silently watch these yapping videos just like how we silently consume text on X today. But from a product design perspective, without looking at any other comments, tell me one reason why this feature may not work on X.
